questions.english: Jim is a college student. → Jim is not (/ isn't) a college student.
questions.japanese: ジムは大学生だ。→ジムは大学生ではない。

questions.english: I like dogs. → I do not (/ don't) like dogs.
questions.japanese: 僕は犬が好きだ。→僕は犬が好きではない。

questions.english: She gets up at seven. → She does not (/ doesn't) get up at seven.
questions.japanese: 彼女は7時に起きる。→彼女は7時に起きない。

questions.english: My brother can ski well. → My brother cannot (/ can't) ski well.
questions.japanese: 私の弟は上手にスキーができる。→私の弟はスキーが上手にできない。

questions.english: Is she a popular singer in Japan? — Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
questions.japanese: 彼女は日本では人気のある歌手ですか。－はい、そうです。/いいえ，違います。

questions.english: Do you like math? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
questions.japanese: 君は数学が好きですか。－はい、好きです。/いいえ、好きではありません。

questions.english: Can Jane ride a bicycle? — Yes, she can. / No, she can't.
questions.japanese: ジェーンは自転車に乗ることができますか。－はい。できます。/いいえ、できません。

questions.english: Isn't Mr. Brown a math teacher? — Yes, he is./ No, he isn't.
questions.japanese: ブラウン先生は数学の先生ではないのですか。－いいえ、数学の先生です。/はい。数学の先生ではありません。

questions.english: Do you like dogs or cats? — I like dogs.
questions.japanese: あなたは犬が好きですか、それとも猫ですか。－僕は犬が好きです。

questions.english: It's windy today, isn't it? -Yes, it is./ No, it isn't.
questions.japanese: 今日は風が強いですね。/強いですか。－はい，強いです。/いいえ、強くありません。

questions.english: Your father doesn't smoke, does he? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
questions.japanese: 君のお父さんはタバコを吸わないですよね。/吸わないのですか。－いいえ、吸います。/はい、吸いません。

questions.english: Who locked the office last night? — John did.
questions.japanese: 昨夜誰が職場の鍵をかけましたか。－ジョンです。

questions.english: When does your school begin? -It begins at 8:30.
questions.japanese: 君の学校は何時に始まりますか。－8時半です。

questions.english: Whose is that hat? — It is mine.
questions.japanese: あの帽子は誰のものですか。－私のです。

questions.english: Sign your name here. - All right.
questions.japanese: ここに署名してください。－わかりました。

questions.english: Bill, don't be late again. - No, I won't.
questions.japanese: ビル、二度と遅刻をしてはいけませんよ。－二度としません。

questions.english: Let's go fishing tomorrow. - Yes, let's. / No, let's not.
questions.japanese: 明日釣りに行きましょう。－そうしましょう。/よしましょう。

questions.english: How cold it is today!
questions.japanese: 今日はなんと寒いのだろう。

questions.english: What a cold day it is today!
questions.japanese: 今日はなんと寒い日なのだろう。

questions.english: I drive to work every day.
questions.japanese: 僕は毎日車で通勤している。

questions.english: The girl on the stage is singing happily.
questions.japanese: 舞台の上の少女は楽しそうに歌っている。

questions.english: Our school starts at 8:30.
questions.japanese: 私たちの学校は8時半に始まる。

questions.english: He has started a new business.
questions.japanese: 彼は新しい事業を始めた。

questions.english: I slept well last night.
questions.japanese: 昨夜はよく眠りました。

questions.english: There is a table by the window.
questions.japanese: 窓のそばにテーブルがあります。

questions.english: Ken won the speech contest. His parents were happy at the news.
questions.japanese: ケンが弁論大会で優勝した。彼の両親はその知らせに喜んでいた。

questions.english: I visited my aunt in Okinawa this summer.
questions.japanese: 私はこの夏に沖縄の叔母さんを訪ねた。

questions.english: It was raining hard. My mother brought me an umbrella.
questions.japanese: 雨が激しく降っていた。お母さんが僕に傘を持ってきてくれた。

questions.english: I was hungry. My mother made me some sandwiches.
questions.japanese: 私は空腹だった。お母さんが私にサンドイッチを作ってくれた。

questions.english: They named their baby Ronald.
questions.japanese: 彼らは赤ちゃんにロナルドと名前をつけた。

questions.english: My hobby makes me happy.
questions.japanese: 趣味は私を幸せにする→趣味があるから私は幸せだ。

questions.english: I usually eat sandwiches for lunch.
questions.japanese: 私はたいていお昼にサンドイッチを食べます。

questions.english: The earth is round. It is not flat.
questions.japanese: 地球は丸い。平らではありません。

questions.english: What is Ted doing now? －He is watching TV in his room.
questions.japanese: テッドは今何をしていますか。―彼は自分の部屋でテレビを見ています。

questions.english: Jane eats breakfast at seven every day.
questions.japanese: ジェーンは毎日7時に朝食を食べる。

questions.english: I know James very well.
questions.japanese: 僕はジェイムズをよく知っている。

questions.english: Is Mary coming？ ― Yes, she is coming at three o’clock.
questions.japanese: メアリーは来ますか。 ―ええ、彼女は3時に来ます。

questions.english: I had a cold and stayed in bed last week.
questions.japanese: 私は先週風邪をひいて寝込んでいた。

questions.english: When I called you, what were you doing?―I was doing my homework.
questions.japanese: 僕が電話した時何をしていたの？ ―宿題をしていました。

questions.english: The newspaper said that the President was coming to Japan soon.
questions.japanese: 新聞には、近々大統領が来日すると書いてあった。

questions.english: I will stop by his apartment on my way to work.
questions.japanese: 仕事に行く途中で彼のアパートに寄ろう。

questions.english: Masaki will pass the entrance exam this year.
questions.japanese: 今年マサキは入学試験に通るだろう。

questions.english: I am going to visit my uncle in Canada this summer.
questions.japanese: この夏に私はカナダの叔父さんを訪ねる予定です。

questions.english: It is going to be chilly tonight.
questions.japanese: 今夜は冷えるだろう。

questions.english: It will probably be raining when you come home.
questions.japanese: 君が家に戻ってくる時にはおそらく雨が降っているだろう。

questions.english: We will be taking off in five minutes.Please fasten your seat belt.
questions.japanese: 5分後に離陸いたします。シートベルトをお締めください。

questions.english: Shall I erase the blackboard? – Yes, please.No, please don’t.[No, thank you.]
questions.japanese: 黒板を消しましょうか。―はい、お願いします。/ いいえ、結構です。

questions.english: Shall we go for a drive? – Yes, let’s. / No, let’s not.
questions.japanese: ドライブに行きませんか。―ええ、そうしましょう。/ やめておこう。

questions.english: Will you pass me the salt, please? – Sure, here you are.
questions.japanese: 塩を取ってくれませんか。 ―はい、どうぞ。

questions.english: Won’t you go shopping with me? – With pleasure.
questions.japanese: 一緒に買い物に行きませんか。 ―喜んで。

questions.english: If it rains tomorrow, we will have classes as usual.
questions.japanese: 明日雨が降れば、いつもの通り授業があります。

questions.english: I haven’t seen Mary recently. What has become of her?
questions.japanese: 私は最近メアリーを見かけない。彼女はどうしたの。

questions.english: Has Cathy ever been to Italy before?
questions.japanese: キャシーはイタリアに行ったことがありますか。

questions.english: Ron has lived here since he was a child.
questions.japanese: ロンは子どもの頃からここに住んでいます。

questions.english: Have you eaten breakfast yet? — Yes, I have just finished it.
questions.japanese: もう朝ごはんを食べましたか。－ええ、今ちょうど終えたところです。

questions.english: Have you ever been to San Francisco? — Yes, I've been there once.
questions.japanese: サンフランシスコに行ったことがありますか。－ええ、一度行きました。

questions.english: How long have you been here? — I've been here for almost two years.
questions.japanese: どれくらいここにいるのですか。－ほぼ２年ここにいます。

questions.english: It has been raining since last week. I hope it will let up soon.
questions.japanese: 先週からずっと雨が降っている。すぐにやんでほしい。

questions.english: I had already gone to bed when you called me.
questions.japanese: 君が電話をかけてきた時には僕はすでに寝てしまっていたんだ。

questions.english: I had been to Paris three times before I went there last year.
questions.japanese: 私は昨年に行った時にはもうすでに３回パリに行ったことがあった。

questions.english: Tom had been in the hospital for a week when I visited him.
questions.japanese: 見舞いに行った時、トムが入院して１週間経っていた。

questions.english: I had been studying English for only one year when I went to the United States.
questions.japanese: 私がアメリカに行った時、英語を勉強してたった１年しか経っていなかった。

questions.english: I lost my watch yesterday. My father had given it to me just that morning for my birthday.
questions.japanese: 私は昨日腕時計をなくした。父がその日の朝、私の誕生日祝いにくれたものだった。

questions.english: I will have finished this work by tomorrow.
questions.japanese: 私は明日までにはこの仕事を終えているでしょう。

questions.english: If I go to Thailand this summer, I will have been there seven times.
questions.japanese: 今年の夏タイに行けば、私はそこに７回行ったことになります。

questions.english: Our parents will have been married for twenty years next month.
questions.japanese: 私たちの両親は、来月には結婚して20年になります。

questions.english: Here we are at the station.
questions.japanese: さあ駅に着いた。

questions.english: Your train leaves here at three o'clock.
questions.japanese: 君の乗る電車は３時にここを出ます。

questions.english: Mike is studying hard these days.
questions.japanese: マイクは最近勉強に精を出している。

questions.english: He is always making silly mistakes. He should be more careful.
questions.japanese: 彼はいつもばかげた間違いばかりしている。もっと注意するべきだ。

questions.english: The traffic signal was changing to red.
questions.japanese: 信号は赤に変わりかけていた。

questions.english: The train was about to leave when I got to the station.
questions.japanese: 私が駅に着いた時、電車はまさに出るところだった。

questions.english: Please return the book when you have read it.
questions.japanese: 読み終わったら、その本を返してください。

questions.english: I had intended to go to the party.
questions.japanese: パーティーに出席するつもりだったんですが。

questions.english: eat～for lunch
questions.japanese: 昼に～を食べる

questions.japanese: 丸い

questions.japanese: 平ら

questions.japanese: 急がば回れ

questions.english: Time flies.
questions.japanese: 光陰矢のごとし

questions.english: twice a week
questions.japanese: 週に2回

questions.english: sleep on it
questions.japanese: 一晩寝てよく考える

questions.english: sleep it off
questions.japanese: 眠って頭痛、酔いなどを取り除く

questions.japanese: 似ている

questions.japanese: ・・・に属している

questions.japanese: 気づく

questions.japanese: 恐れている

questions.english: respect
questions.japanese: 尊敬している

questions.english: hate
questions.japanese: 憎んでいる

questions.english: believe
questions.japanese: 信じている

questions.english: see
questions.japanese: 会う、付き合う

questions.english: You are being very quiet today.
questions.japanese: 今日はいやに静かだね。

questions.english: I believe he will win.
questions.japanese: 彼が勝つと信じている

questions.english: get married
questions.japanese: 結婚する

questions.english: have a cold
questions.japanese: 風邪をひく

questions.english: stay in bed
questions.japanese: 寝込む

questions.english: break out
questions.japanese: 勃発する

questions.english: go to work
questions.japanese: 仕事に行く

questions.english: for a change
questions.japanese: いつもと違って

questions.english: World War Ⅱ
questions.japanese: 第二次世界大戦

questions.english: around midnight
questions.japanese: 真夜中ごろ

questions.english: the President
questions.japanese: 大統領

questions.english: stop by
questions.japanese: 立ち寄る

questions.english: on my way to work
questions.japanese: 仕事に行く途中で
